## Life Summary

Shirley Edna Parker was the youngest child of [[William Henry Parker (1893–1968)]] and [[Caroline Edna Lawrie (1890–1957)]], born at the family farm at Long Plains, South Australia. She married [[Murray John Telfer (1924–2009)]], uniting the Parker and Telfer families.

She was the grandmother of [[Mark Kenneth Telfer (1986–?)]] through her son [[Timothy Neil Telfer (1959–?)]].

## Family Stories

Shirley Edna Parker married Murray John Telfer, the ninth child of Francis Charles and Amy Telfer. Together they raised three sons — Darryl William, John Robert and Grantley Keith — carrying on the farming tradition of the Telfer family on the Eyre Peninsula. *(From the Borders to the Bush, p.175)*
